name: Addazahr (Backbiter)
appearance: A slender pale-amber flying insect about 2 inches long, with a straw-like body and nearly transparent wings.

Special attacks.name: Bite
Special attacks.effectNote: Deals 1 damage. A human or non-burden animal saves vs. paralyzation or develops sore, swollen joints. The separate beast-of-burden rule causes back pain and weakness that prevents carrying loads or traveling far.

Special attacks.name: Recovery
Special attacks.effectNote: A cure disease spell cures the effect. Without magical treatment it lasts about two weeks.

Traits.name: Fragile
Traits.effectNote: Any hit destroys an individual. Normal or magical cold and fire can harm it. It drowns if submerged and prevented from getting out.

Encounters.name: Arrival at Adhal
Encounters.effectNote: The affected camels show symptoms on the second night of travel. A successful Desert Survival or Healing proficiency check identifies the cause. See Adventure Book p. 8.

notes: Neutral, animal intelligence 1, morale 6. Uncommon, daytime, omnivorous, and encountered in groups of 6–60. The block gives each insect 1 HP.
The source gives a paralyzation save for people and other animals and gives no separate save in the beast-of-burden paragraph.
The second-night timing belongs to the camel encounter. The animal entry gives no general onset time.
TSR, Corsairs of the Great Sea (1994), unnumbered Monstrous Compendium leaf, p. 100.

name: Electric Eel
appearance: A long-bodied electric eel, 9 ft. long in the printed encounter.

Special attacks.name: Electric discharge
Special attacks.effectNote: Once an hour, the eel releases a shock in a 15-ft. radius. It deals 3d8 electrical damage within 5 ft., 2d8 from 5 to 10 ft., and 1d8 to everyone else within range.

Encounters.name: Reception Pool
Encounters.effectNote: The eel attacks disturbances in area 4’s water-filled pit. A character who falls in begins within 5 ft. unless they flee as soon as they spot the eel.

notes: Neutral, nonintelligent, morale 7. The encounter fixes this eel at 16 HP.
The printed distance bands overlap at exactly 5 ft. The source gives no saving throw for the discharge.
TSR, Corsairs of the Great Sea (1994), Adventure Book p. 24.

name: Shark
appearance: A shark about 12 ft. long in the Terrapin Isle encounter.

Encounters.name: Terrapin Isle
Encounters.effectNote: Six sharks accompany the malenti in the water and attack characters forced into it. They are listed at 40 HP and 420 XP each.

notes: TSR, Corsairs of the Great Sea (1994), Adventure Book p. 52.

name: Giant Shark
appearance: A gargantuan shark, about 30 ft. long in the Terrapin Isle encounter.

Special attacks.name: Swallow whole
Special attacks.effectNote: The giant shark can swallow prey when its attack roll is at least 4 above the minimum needed to hit. Swallowed creatures take 20 damage each round. They can attack from within at a cumulative −1 penalty per round. Killing the shark is the only printed escape.

Encounters.name: Terrapin Isle
Encounters.effectNote: Two giant sharks are listed in the malenti encounter, with 68 HP and 3,000 XP each.

notes: TSR, Corsairs of the Great Sea (1994), Adventure Book p. 52.
